title: Cheesy Sloppy Joe Garlic Toast
description: A delicious and easy dinner idea combining sloppy joe filling with cheesy garlic Texas toast.
steps: Cook the frozen garlic Texas toast according to the package instructions.
Use the back of a spoon to mash down in the middle of each toast slice to create a small well.
Brown the ground beef in a skillet until fully cooked.
Add the can of sloppy joe sauce to the cooked ground beef and stir to combine.
Place a slice of provolone cheese over each piece of toast.
Return the assembled toasts to the oven at 425°F and bake for 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and everything is toasted.
notes:
Adjust cooking time as needed to melt cheese and toast to your preference.
